_comment: Copy to hosts.local.json (gitignored) and declare your own bench fleet.
This is where a fleet lives: hosts.json carries the shape and the ports and
travels with the repository, this file describes one room and stays in it.
Entries merge over hosts.json on 'id': the id 'local' completes the machine
running the campaign, any other id adds a machine. Every field except 'id'
is optional — see the field list at the top of hosts.json.
Prefer 'sshAlias', pointing at an entry of ~/.ssh/config, over a password
written in a file, wherever the machine allows it.

machines.label: the workstation this campaign runs from
laptop on the bench, hardware encoder
VM with no GPU — compatibility only, never perf

ports._comment: Optional. Only the keys a site actually shifts; the rest keep the defaults of hosts.json. Wolf answers where GameStream does, so a machine running both rebases one.
